change_summary: Add an experiment-only downside_path_share_20 OHLCV field and sweep a cap-aware top-up for non-ETF/non-Commodity core signals in the same-day bottom quartile of that field.

field_check.note: This risk-allocation experiment does not depend on these fields.

rule_dependencies: OHLCV Close series through signal day

hypothesis: Already-qualified core stock signals with bottom-quartile prior-20-day downside-path share have cleaner trend persistence. A small cap-aware risk top-up should improve expected_value_score without changing entry, exit, ranking, universe, news, or LLM logic.
known_risks: High multiple-testing risk because this is adjacent to recent OHLCV daily-return-path scouts.
If accepted, production parity requires shared feature and sizing implementation before use.
A small top-up can still be cap-bound and may not move executed shares.

next_retry_requires: Stop retrying daily-return-path allocation fields on the same frozen windows unless forward replacement-value rows arrive.
Prefer candidate-pool or event replacement-value evidence over more local price-path threshold sweeps.
notes: No JavaScript used. This is alpha_search, not measurement repair.

parameters.field_definition: sum(abs(negative close-to-close returns)) divided by sum(abs(all close-to-close returns)) over last 20 signal-known trading days

production_impact.promotion_required_if_accepted: Move downside_path_share_20 feature, bottom-quartile state, and cap-aware top-up into shared feature_layer/risk_engine/portfolio_engine with tests, then rerun the same three-window protocol.
